reviews.x: I am very happy with this purchase! The rotary knob for the speed setting allows for a great range of speed from very fast to very slow. A separate switch allows one to forward and reverse the rotation of the drill. When on, the electric file is quiet and very stable, there is hardly a vibration of the electric file when at low, medium and medium high speed, I can't imagine one would ever require use of this e-file at its highest speed. reviews.x: I had a more expensive Dremel tool which made me a little weary of it. Was a little too powerful. I ordered this one and I couldn't be any happier. It does a great job. I definitely recommend this for the money.

I bought this for my dogs nails.  It is whisper quiet and you can adjust speed.  Works great and I have used it around the house also.  Love it!

Love this nail drill. Very easy to use even for a beginner like me. Only wish the on/off switch was on the drill itself, instead of the chord, but that is certainly not a deal breaker. Very comfortable to operate, the speed adjustment is continuous and smooth. Being able to choose drill spinning direction is awesome. Overall very happy with this little gadget.
Excellence product. Fast delivery. 6 months ago, I bought drill from Ali Express... Don't even want to compare. You can use it for acrylic, gel, dipping powder removal with no issues. Thank you.
I have to say this machine is allll you need!!!!! Thank you for the quick delievery! Best package ever!!!

reviews.t: Excellent value. It is quiet and smooth
reviews.x: Exactly what I was looking for. Excellent value. It is quiet and smooth. Perfect product!

reviews.t: Excellent value. It is quiet and smooth
reviews.x: Exactly what I was looking for. Excellent value. It is quiet and smooth. Perfect product!

I love this drill , I highly recommend this drill for my nail studants and  professional nail technician on the go , it is a light and has a metal hand piece ,nice and smooth vary little if any vibration , the color is pink , my only problem is the cord is not long enough, and if the cord is damaged you can not replace it , only the cord ,and if you use an extension cord , it adds  extra weight  to the cord. And the bits that were given as a gift are not what I expected , but you can buy better

Maybe it was just this particular unit, but the one time I used it was enough for me. Between needing to use it, while it was powered off and plugged in, the device got increasingly hotter to the touch. I was afraid it may actually cause a fire. It did the job, but I bought it 2 days ago and sadly, it was returned today for safety concerns.

Works great on feet and regular nails. Never tried it on  acrylic nails  but with the power it has, I don’t see it not working well on them. It’s worth every penny to me. the attachments are great! I would recommend this product

I love it!  It is easy to hold. Plenty powerful. Does not slow like many I've tried do. Lots of different tip styles. Quiet and powerful. I have only used it on low. High is not necessary, for my needs, but is definitely there.
Excellent. My husband is diabetic with thick fungus nails.  Nothing worked but going to Dr., except this. Did an excellent job reducing thickness and shortening.
The drill bits did not fit into the handle.  Would not function properly.  Had to return
the only thing i would really change about this is the placement of the speed setting

I had this for about a week before it broke. Everything about it was easy to use and I loved the sleek design. I used it for about three days when I noticed that it was heating up so hot that I couldn’t hold it in my hand. I thought I was being excessive so I would use it for a minute- let it cool down- use it- cool it down- and so on. After a week of this, the on/off switch broke off- not like you would think. It didn’t snap, it lightly just fell off. This had the potential to be a great produc

I bought this product when I began doing my own dip powder. I used it every 3 weeks or so and only to dull the top coat from before. A week ago I was using it and it became too hot to hold. I let it cool down and tried again. Instantly hot and then it just stopped. It doesn’t work anymore. So now back to shopping for a dependable product. Quite sure I’m out of luck getting my money back after a few months. I do NOT recommend this product.

I wasn’t sure what to expect for the price, but I am pleased. It works well and comes with many options to change out. I get my nails done every 3 weeks at different salons, but sometimes I just want the option to shape my own nails myself. I do not use this frequently or on others, but for my own use or for the use of friends and family, it’s perfect. It also doesn’t feel cheap, which was a concern of mine as well.

reviews.t: Not bad purchase but probably got a faulty item
reviews.x: Was easy to use, only use 2 times. Then didn’t work anymore. I had it for couple years now in my beauty room sitting & wasn’t using too much so now disappointment it doesn’t work now. Wish I would used it more in the beginning when I bought it to get a exchange or refund.

reviews.t: I have four of these and love them so much
reviews.x: I'm noticing the drills are starting to change so I'm collection this style. I've used a lot of different ones, this style is my favorite. Great seller, I've ordered from them here and on eBay. Thanks a ton for the extra drill bits

I liked this drill and it worked well for a month.  Literally the day after I could return it, it broke.  Completely stopped working in the middle of a manicure.  I’m very disappointed.  Don’t waste your money.

Using this drill for doll modification. It is amazing. I can’t believe I ever tried it without one of these.  The fact that you can control the speeds as well as go to different directions is crazy and amazing.
Just did not turn on. This was a Christmas gift for my mom & how embarrassing that it didn't work! Returned & she ended up buying her own w/a gift card I got her. Big bummer here.

reviews.t: Makes my nails look so much better. Highly recommend it for a non-nail techie.
reviews.x: Liked everything about it!  Easy to use and does great job!  UPDATE:  So sorry to say. It just died on me and I tried to get it to work!  Gave up and tossed it in garbage!!  🤬

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the drill as quiet and smooth with little vibration.
Many customers consider it excellent value for the money and recommend it.
Users like the adjustable, continuous speed control and forward/reverse rotation.
A few reviewers report overheating or fire-hazard safety concerns.
Some reviewers mention issues with the cord or drill bits not fitting.
